controles.affirmation: Litige fiscal indien : l'ITD reclame 349 M$ sur le rachat d'actions 2016, depot de 365 M$ au 30 juin 2026, recours rejete par la CITA en mars 2022 et par l'ITAT en septembre 2023, pendant devant la Haute Cour de Chennai, second differend 2013 sans demande chiffree
controles.verbatim_source: In March 2018, the ITD asserted that it is owed an additional 33 billion Indian rupees ($349 million at the June 30, 2026 exchange rate) on the 2016 transaction... Our appeal was ruled on unfavorably by the CITA in March 2022 and by the ITAT in September 2023... the case is pending before the High Court. As of June 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025, the deposit with the ITD was $365 million and $384 million... The dispute in relation to the 2013 share repurchase transaction is also in litigation. At this time, the ITD has not made specific demands with regards to the 2013 transaction.
controles.correction_proposee: Correction de reference : la note est la Note 7 (Commitments and Contingencies) du 10-Q T2 2026, pas la Note 11.

controles.affirmation: Il restait 2,3 Mds$ disponibles sur la ligne de credit renouvelable au 30 juin 2026
controles.verbatim_source: During the second quarter of 2026, we borrowed $1,000 million under our revolving credit facility, bringing the available capacity under our credit facility to $850 million. [Les 2 338 M$ sont autre chose : 'The repurchase program does not have an expiration date and had a remaining balance of $2,338 million as of June 30, 2026.']
controles.correction_proposee: Confusion entre la capacite restante du revolver (850 M$) et le solde restant de l'AUTORISATION de rachat d'actions (2 338 M$). Ecrire : 'il restait 850 M$ de capacite disponible sur la ligne de credit renouvelable au 30 juin 2026'. La nuance devient d'ailleurs bien moins rassurante.

controles.affirmation: Les acquisitions recentes contribuent a elles seules environ 90 a 100 points de base de la croissance du segment Produits & Ressources
controles.verbatim_source: Our recently completed acquisitions contributed approximately 100 basis points to overall revenue growth, across all segments in North America (trimestre) ; ... approximately 90 basis points to overall revenue growth, across all segments in North America (six mois)
controles.correction_proposee: Le document parle de la croissance CONSOLIDEE, tous segments confondus, pas du segment Produits & Ressources. Aucune ventilation par segment de l'apport des acquisitions n'est publiee. Ecrire : 'les acquisitions recentes ont apporte environ 100 points de base a la croissance consolidee du trimestre, tous segments confondus' et retirer l'attribution a Produits & Ressources.

controles.affirmation: L'approbation say-on-pay recueille 94% des voix lors de l'AGM 2026
controles.verbatim_source: the Compensation Committee considered the significant level of shareholder support our executive compensation program received from shareholders in 2025 (94% support), 2024 (92% support) and prior years. (Proxy 2026, depose le 17/04/2026)
controles.correction_proposee: Les 94% sont le vote de l'assemblee 2025. Le proxy 2026 a ete depose le 17 avril 2026, avant l'assemblee 2026 : il ne peut pas en donner le resultat, et aucun 8-K de resultats d'assemblee 2026 n'est disponible. Ecrire : 'l'assemblee 2025 avait approuve la remuneration a 94% (92% en 2024)'.

controles.affirmation: La dette a long terme passe de 543 M$ fin 2025 a 1 527 M$ fin juin 2026, soit +173% ; la tresorerie chute de 42% sur la meme periode, a 1 038 M$
controles.verbatim_source: Long-term debt, net of current maturities $1,527 (30/06/2026) / $543 (31/12/2025). Cash and cash equivalents $1,038 (30/06/2026) / $1,901 (31/12/2025) ; Cash and cash equivalents, end of period $1,038 / $1,796 (30/06/2025)
controles.correction_proposee: Melange de deux bases de comparaison. Sur la periode citee (31/12/2025 au 30/06/2026), la dette progresse de +181% et la tresorerie recule de 45,4% (1 901 a 1 038 M$). Les +173% et -42% sont des variations SUR UN AN (vs 30 juin 2025, tresorerie 1 796 M$). Choisir une seule base : soit '+181% et -45% en six mois', soit '+173% et -42% sur un an'. Le hook (-42% en un an) est, lui, exact.

controles.affirmation: Cognizant a emprunte 1 000 M$ sur sa ligne de credit renouvelable pour financer, au meme trimestre, l'acquisition d'Astreya et 1 153 M$ de rachats d'actions
controles.verbatim_source: During the second quarter of 2026, we repurchased $1,153 million of our Class A common stock under our stock repurchase program: $653 million through open market purchases and $500 million through ASR agreements. Additionally, we completed our acquisition of Astreya for a purchase price of $634 million, including contingent consideration of $25 million, net of cash acquired, while borrowing $1,000 million under our revolving credit facility.
controles.correction_proposee: Le 10-Q rattache l'emprunt de 1 000 M$ a l'acquisition d'Astreya ('while borrowing'), pas aux rachats d'actions. Le lien de financement avec le buyback est une deduction, pas une declaration de la societe. Ecrire : 'Cognizant a emprunte 1 000 M$ au moment ou elle bouclait l'acquisition d'Astreya et rachetait pour 1 153 M$ d'actions dans le meme trimestre'.

controles.affirmation: T2 2026 : CA 5 481 M$ (+4,5%), resultat net 636 M$ (-1,4%), taux d'impot 26,4% (+3,0 pt), marge nette 11,6% (-0,7 pt), marge brute 33,4% (-0,3 pt), marge operationnelle GAAP 15,9% (+0,3 pt), 84 M$ de charges Project Leap
controles.verbatim_source: Revenues $5,481 / $5,245 ; Restructuring charges 84 / — ; Provision for income taxes (231) / (197) ; Income before provision for income taxes 875 / 842 ; Net income $636 / $645. 'Our GAAP operating margin increased to 15.9%... from 15.6%'. 'we incurred $84 million of employee separation and other costs'
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance omise : le 10-Q precise que la marge operationnelle GAAP du T2 2026 a ete penalisee par les 84 M$ de Project Leap ET soutenue par une reprise de 81 M$ sur l'obligation de retraite indienne de 2019 - deux elements exceptionnels qui se compensent. Le +0,3 pt n'est donc pas purement operationnel.

controles.affirmation: Remuneration du PDG Ravi Kumar S de 21,53 M$ pour 2025, +28,2%, prime annuelle a 169% de la cible, ecart de 477 fois avec le salarie median (45 138 $) ; resultat net 2025 de 2 230 M$ contre 2 240 M$ en 2024
controles.verbatim_source: Proxy 2026 : total 2025 $21,532,448 ; total 2024 $16,801,707 (soit +28,2%) ; median employee pay 45,138 ; ratio 477:1 ; 'In 2025, ACI was paid at 169% of target'. 10-K FY2025 : net income 2,230 / 2,240

controles.affirmation: Risque Project Leap reconnu par la societe (perte de savoir-faire, recrutement, retention, aucune assurance de succes)
controles.verbatim_source: Project Leap may disrupt operations, cause the loss of institutional knowledge and expertise, and harm our ability to recruit new employees and retain our remaining employees, all of which could have an adverse effect on our ability to deliver client services and execute on our business plan. There can be no assurance that we will be successful in implementing Project Leap. (10-Q T1 2026, Item 1A)

controles.affirmation: Segments : CMT 854 M$ (+1,5%), Produits & Ressources 1 322 M$ (+1,2%), demande discretionnaire plus faible dans le commerce, les biens de consommation, le voyage et l'hotellerie
controles.verbatim_source: Products and Resources 16 / 1.2% ; CMT 13 / 1.5% ; Total revenues $236 / 4.5%. 'Our Products and Resources segment saw softer discretionary spend among retail, consumer goods, travel and hospitality customers'

controles.affirmation: Environ 23% des couts d'exploitation en roupies indiennes, 1% de variation de change deplace la marge operationnelle d'environ 17 pb, la depreciation de la roupie a soutenu la marge de 50 pb en 2025
controles.verbatim_source: A predominant portion of our costs in India are denominated in the Indian rupee, representing approximately 23% of our global operating costs during the year ended December 31, 2025... Including the impact of the hedges, the depreciation of the Indian rupee positively impacted our operating margin for the year ended December 31, 2025 by 50 basis points... Each additional 1.0% change in exchange rate between the Indian rupee and the U.S. dollar will have the effect of moving our operating margin by approximately 17 basis points (excluding the impact of our cash flow hedges).
controles.correction_proposee: Le verbatim cite tronque la restriction '(excluding the impact of our cash flow hedges)', qui est materielle : les 17 pb valent HORS couvertures. Retablir la mention.

controles.affirmation: DSO de 88 jours au T2 2026 contre 81 jours fin 2025 et 77 jours fin 2023
controles.verbatim_source: Our DSO was 88 days as of June 30, 2026, an increase of 7 days from 81 days as of December 31, 2025. Our DSO was 83 days as of June 30, 2025... 10-K FY2025 : 'Our DSO was 81 days as of December 31, 2025, 78 days as of December 31, 2024 and 77 days as of December 31, 2023.'
